frame.note: fixed, topmost, never transformed; its transparent window is the clip mask of every moving layer

fg.note: foreground energies and props, large, moves with the tilt

rule: offset_px = tilt(-1..1) * depth * amplitude * window_width_px, both axes. Displayed layer size = window * max(rect, 1 + 2*|depth|*amplitude + 0.01) so no edge can show.

legacyLayers.fg: only for placeholder cards that still point to v1 layers; HQ cards use energy
